I've always wondered about these. I try to limit them to times when I know I'm going to be extremely active. You know, the package shows a guy rock climbing so I use it when I hike, run, or do long cycling trips. I think I'm ok, but what if I wanted to eat them a little more often? Are these basically snickers bars hiding behind a fitness mask?

Here's a link to the Nutritional Information on their site. Link

Notice that the first ingredient listed is brown rice syrup (meaning that a bar contains more brown rice syrup than any other ingredient). I found this article on brown rice syrup. It seems that it's included as just a way for them to avoid writing glucose (sugar) on the package.
